# Machine-First Design Agent Wiki
> Curated High-Performance UI Registries & Anti-Slop Safeguards

## System Architecture & Endpoints
- Registry Index: /r/registry.json
- Component Items: /r/[name].json
- Raw Markdown Docs: /raw/components/[slug]
- MCP Server: npx @design-wiki/mcp

## Available Registry Components (27 verified zero-slop items)

### Category: ui:primitive
- [avatar](/r/avatar.json): Fallback-aware image avatar with initials display and smooth loading states. (Variance: 2, Motion: 1, Density: 6)
  - Tags: radix-primitives, avatar, image, headless
  - Install: npx shadcn@latest add http://localhost:3000/r/avatar.json
- [badge](/r/badge.json): Contrast-checked status indicator using semantic design tokens. (Variance: 2, Motion: 1, Density: 8)
  - Tags: tailwind-v4, status, indicator, badge
